title: Book Conor Pederson — Weddings, College Events & Private Parties
metaDescription: Book Conor Pederson for weddings, college events, and private parties within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh. Vocals and acoustic guitar across Pop, R&B, Country, Hip-Hop, and the classics.
heroImageAlt: Conor Pederson singing and playing acoustic guitar on stage under a spotlight
intro: Conor books weddings, private parties, and college events within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh — the South Hills and North Hills, Washington and Westmoreland counties, out to Morgantown and Wheeling, West Virginia, and Youngstown, Ohio. He performs solo: vocals and acoustic guitar, across Pop, R&B, Country, Hip‑Hop, and the classics.

sections.heading: What Conor Plays
sections.body: A solo acoustic set — vocals and guitar, no backing band required — built from originals and a wide covers range spanning Pop, R&B, Country, Hip‑Hop, and the classics. The set adapts to the room: quiet and conversational for a ceremony or dinner hour, full-energy for a dance floor or a crowd that wants to sing along.

sections.heading: Service Area
sections.body: Pittsburgh is home base. Most bookings land within about 100 miles — Pittsburgh proper, the South Hills, North Hills, Washington County, and Westmoreland County, plus Morgantown and Wheeling, West Virginia, and Youngstown, Ohio. A little further out? Ask — travel dates happen too.

sections.heading: How Booking Works
sections.body: Send the date, location, and event type through the form below or email conorpedersonmusic@gmail.com directly. No marketplace listing and no added booking fee — you're talking straight to Conor, not a booking coordinator.

faqs.q: How far will Conor travel for a booking?
faqs.a: Most bookings stay within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh. For anything further, reach out and ask — travel dates are considered case by case.

faqs.q: Is it cheaper to book through a marketplace like GigSalad or The Bash instead?
faqs.a: Booking direct means no marketplace listing fee added to your quote, and you're coordinating straight with Conor rather than through a third party.
